summary: Add bounded external-assistant conversation discovery, timeline, search and grant-bound content readback under the existing conversation scope

replay.detail: No authoritative claim format or replay change; search and paging projections are derived from existing conversation records.

schema.detail: Client-v0 adds four assistant conversation read operations and their request models. Responses reuse allowlisted bounded JSON projections; no sender or recipient fields or new scopes are introduced.

rules.detail: The four new reads require only read.assistant.conversation and existing read authorization. Discovery cursors and issued content references bind to the authenticated grant policy. Native tool, diagnostic, attachment and environment bodies remain excluded.

compatibility.detail: Generated clients add conversation list, detail, timeline and search methods. Assistant clients must copy returned read handles and byte ranges instead of synthesizing native references; native person conversation reads are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon and adapter replacement is sufficient; no activation is performed by this change.

manual.detail: No grant widening or policy change is required. Deployment and activation remain separate operator steps.

recovery.detail: After a grant policy change or daemon restart, rediscover conversation handles instead of replaying invalidated references and cursors.
